{
  "name": "agent-models",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Pins the model each subagent type runs on, set in /config or with /agent-models",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "explore": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Explore agents",
      "description": "Model for Explore subagents. inherit leaves the choice to the agent definition, then the main model.",
      "default": "haiku",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable"
      ]
    },
    "generalPurpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "general-purpose agents",
      "description": "Model for general-purpose subagents.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable"
      ]
    },
    "plan": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Plan agents",
      "description": "Model for Plan subagents.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable"
      ]
    },
    "other": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Every other type",
      "description": "Model for any subagent type not named above or in Custom.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "inherit",
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus",
        "fable"
      ]
    },
    "custom": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom",
      "description": "More types, as type=model pairs separated by commas: code-reviewer=opus, claude-code-guide=haiku",
      "default": ""
    },
    "force": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Override explicit models",
      "description": "Also replace a model the caller asked for. Off: a pin applies only when no model was given.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
